summary: Nexalin Technology filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 2,419,354 common shares at $0.31 per share to a single accredited investor under an August 19, 2026 securities purchase agreement, grossing roughly $750,000. A concurrent private placement covers 1,209,677 PIPE warrants (50% of shares purchased) at $0.50, immediately exercisable with a 9.99% beneficial ownership cap and one-year term. The company will file an S-1/S-3 resale registration within 20 business days. This is a routine capital-raising takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and warrant overhang.
